elements.description: Stacked bar chart, y-axis titled 'Share of employment (%)' ranging 0 to 100 in steps of 20; x-axis categories: Cambodia, Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam. Legend: Low digital occupations (teal), Medium digital occupations (orange), Highly digital occupations (grey). Printed values: Cambodia – Low 71.1%, Medium 28.6%, Highly 0.3% (label above bar); Thailand – Low 63.6%, Medium 33.4%, Highly 3% (label above bar); Malaysia – Low 72.5%, Medium 26.1%, Highly 1.4% (label above bar); Vietnam – Low 73.9%, Medium 24.7%, Highly 1.4% (label above bar). Pattern: low digital occupations make up roughly 64–74% of employment in every economy, with Vietnam and Malaysia highest in low-digital share and Thailand having the largest medium and highly digital shares.
